name: quickbooks-mcp
description: Every QuickBooks Online Accounting entity, plus an offline SQLite mirror, cross-entity search, and AR/AP aging no SDK or read-only MCP ships.

quickbooks_access_token.title: QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN
quickbooks_access_token.description:
OAuth 2.0 bearer access token sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Obtain one
from the Intuit OAuth 2.0 Playground or mint it from a refresh token with `quickbooks-cli
auth refresh`. Required scope: com.intuit.quickbooks.accounting.

quickbooks_realm_id.title: QUICKBOOKS_REALM_ID
quickbooks_realm_id.description:
Your QuickBooks Online company (realm) ID. It scopes every request to one company.
Find it in the Intuit Developer dashboard or the connected-company URL. Without it
(or a full QUICKBOOKS_BASE_URL) the CLI has no company to target.

quickbooks_environment.title: QUICKBOOKS_ENVIRONMENT
quickbooks_environment.description:
Which Intuit host to target: `production` (default) or `sandbox`. Combined with
QUICKBOOKS_REALM_ID it builds the base URL automatically.
